_comment: Head numbers are vanilla 26.1.2 ToolMaterial constants, read from the game jar. Handle multipliers are Temper's own and straddle 1.0 so the handle is a trade, not an upgrade. Adding a material is a new entry here and nothing else. Colours are calibrated against the vanilla item after tinting: the blade body (90% grey times the colour) lands on the item's main tone, except for materials that are dark to begin with, where the colour is raised until the zone means match; see scripts/sword-sprite.py --calibrate.
